title: Stay Fair! Ensuring Group Fairness in Diffusion Models Across Guidance Scales
topic: Social Aspects->Fairness, Equity, Justice and Safety
claim: Fairness tuned at one control setting drifts when users change that setting; our method keeps it stable across the whole range.
layout: 3 panels, left-to-right: UI mockup then two line plots with parity lines
description: The figure has three panels. Panel (a), 'Problem', is a mock settings window titled 'Diffusion Model Settings'. It has model choice (FLUX.2 selected, SD1.5), a prompt field, and a guidance-scale slider from low to high. The slider has ghost cursors and a double-headed arrow, captioned 'User adjusts the scale'. Above it is the headline 'Group fairness should be preserved at any user selected scale.' Panels (b) and (c) are line plots of female ratio (%) against guidance scale. (b) is a vanilla FLUX.2 model on 'Painter'. (c) is an SD1.5 + fine-tuned debiased model on 'Firefighter'. Each plot has a dark grey line for standard guidance, which drifts sharply. A blue line for StayFair stays flat near the starting point. Dashed parity lines and curved blue arrows show the correction. The legend uses a red ✗ for 'varies' and a blue ✓ for 'stable'. Blue is the accent colour.
caption: StayFair maintains group fairness as users vary the guidance scale. (a) Users adjust the guidance scale to generate outputs that match their preferences. Since fairness should hold regardless of users’ scale choices within the specified range, we extend the group fairness requirement across that range of scales. (b,c) Prior work that examines bias or optimizes fairness at a fixed guidance scale is insufficient for fairness across scales: group ratios drift in both vanilla (FLUX.2 [10]) and debiased (SD1.5 + FT [7]) models. StayFair stabilizes group ratios across scales, mitigating average and worst total bias depending on the setting.
abstract: Diffusion models steer conditional generation with a tunable guidance scale to trade off prompt alignment and diversity. However, existing debiasing techniques are optimized for a single scale, degrading fairness when users adjust this parameter. We trace this behavior to a previously overlooked source by decomposing total bias into two components: a model bias and a guidance bias. While prior work primarily targets the former, we show that the guidance bias varies with the guidance scale, persisting even in models that have already been debiased. To address this, we extend Strong Demographic Parity to guidance and derive a condition under which the target distribution retains its group ratio across guidance scales. Building on this condition, we propose StayFair, which designs fair guidance algorithms in both regimes. For classifier guidance, it equalizes the classifier's output distributions across groups; for classifier-free guidance, it shifts the null embedding by a prompt-dependent offset. Because StayFair modifies only the guidance step, it is orthogonal to model debiasing and can be layered onto existing fair diffusion models. Across class-conditional and text-to-image generation, StayFair decouples fairness from the guidance scale without sacrificing image quality. Our decomposition also enables a more detailed analysis of the sources of bias in diffusion models.
